title: Authenticated DIO admission omits canonical IPv6 envelope checks
description: spec/09-packets-timing.md §13.3 requires a canonical multicast DIO to use validated Rule 255, IPv6 destination ff02::1a, correct link-local scope, and Hop Limit 255 before routing mutation. python/src/lichen/rpl/authenticated_dio.py checks only Next Header, ICMP type/code/checksum and DIO scope fields; it accepts signed DIOs encoded under another SCHC rule or carried to arbitrary unicast/global destinations and with arbitrary Hop Limit. This also affects fragmented-DIO issuance. Reject non-Rule-255/non-ff02::1a/non-255 envelopes (or precisely document and implement any separately authorized unicast profile) and add direct and fragmented admission regressions.
